_about: Short plain-English explanations of each market drop and industry move, written from that week's headlines. Key: 'drop|<start>' or '<industry>|<start>'. fetch_market_moves.py attaches them; a move without one shows its headlines only.
ai|2026-10-12: Chip stocks sold off as doubts about the AI boom grew: Broadcom's and Intel's bosses warned about how AI spending is being funded, Microsoft is building its own AI chip (less need for Nvidia's), and Chinese rivals Huawei and CXMT are catching up. Oil near $110 added to the nerves.
ai|2026-09-16: Chip stocks bounced back as investors looked past earlier AI worries. A Federal Reserve meeting, falling bond yields and fresh AI optimism pushed the Nasdaq to a record high, led by Intel, AMD and Arm.
ai|2026-07-29: The AI trade roared back after its July slump. Memory chipmakers (Micron, SK Hynix, Samsung) jumped on strong demand, and Palantir and Oracle rose on earnings; analysts argued the sell-off had gone too far.
ai|2026-07-23: Chip stocks fell hard, led by memory makers, on worries that Big Tech's AI spending is too high ahead of their earnings reports. The war with Iran pushed oil and bond yields up, which hurts expensive tech stocks most.
ai|2026-06-04: Broadcom's results rattled the AI trade and dragged Broadcom, Micron, Arm and other chipmakers down. Rising odds of a Fed rate hike made the Nasdaq and S&P 500 have their worst day of the year, while other sectors held up.
ai|2026-05-19: A buying frenzy in chip stocks ahead of Nvidia's results: fear of missing out drove Arm, Marvell and Super Micro up 60–90%, even as some experts warned prices had run too far too fast.
ai|2026-04-30: Chip stocks rallied after Big Tech companies said they would keep spending heavily on AI, and AMD and Qualcomm reported strong results. Memory makers Micron and Samsung hit record values.
ai|2026-04-08: Tech and chip stocks jumped after President Trump announced a ceasefire with Iran, which eased fears about oil and the economy. Strong monthly sales from TSMC showed AI chip demand still growing.
ai|2025-09-04: Oracle's forecast that AI-driven cloud revenue would soar, and a $10 billion chip deal for Broadcom, set off a rally across AI stocks. Oracle alone rose nearly 50%.
ai|2025-05-07: AI stocks rose as the Trump administration moved to scrap Biden-era limits on exporting chips, Nvidia and AMD signed big chip deals with Saudi Arabia, and the US–China trade truce lifted tech.
ai|2025-04-22: AI stocks recovered from the tariff crash as the trade war eased and Wall Street argued fears of an AI slowdown were overdone.
ai|2025-04-07: Chip stocks bounced sharply after President Trump paused most of his new tariffs for 90 days, and reports said he would hold off on curbing Nvidia's chip sales to China.
ai|2025-03-31: Chip stocks plunged after President Trump announced sweeping 'Liberation Day' tariffs; investors feared chipmakers could not escape them and that a recession would cut demand.
ai|2025-02-21: AI stocks slid on worries about possible new chip export controls and a slowdown in AI demand after the DeepSeek shock, ahead of Nvidia's results.
ai|2025-01-15: AI stocks jumped when President Trump announced the $500 billion 'Stargate' AI data-centre project with OpenAI, Oracle and SoftBank, at the start of his second term.
ai|2024-09-09: Chip stocks bounced after Nvidia's CEO calmed worries about demand and Oracle reported strong AI-driven cloud growth.
ai|2024-08-08: AI stocks recovered from the early-August global sell-off as investors bought the dip in Nvidia and other beaten-down names.
ai|2024-08-01: AI and chip stocks crashed in a global sell-off: Intel's disastrous results, weak US jobs data and recession fears, a reported delay to Nvidia's next AI chip, and the unwinding of a popular yen-funded trade.
ai|2024-02-02: Strong earnings set off an AI buying frenzy: Arm more than doubled after its results and Super Micro soared on demand for AI servers.
ai|2024-01-18: Strong results and forecasts from TSMC, ASML and Super Micro showed AI chip demand booming, and Microsoft hit a $3 trillion value.
ai|2023-05-22: Nvidia's blowout forecast for AI chip sales started the AI stock boom, adding nearly $300 billion to AI stocks in days.
defense|2026-08-17: Defense stocks fell after L3Harris's CEO stepped down following a conduct review and Lockheed Martin dropped, with AeroVironment falling hardest.
defense|2026-07-31: Defense stocks rose on strong quarterly results (Kratos, Leidos, Booz Allen) and progress on the 'Golden Dome' missile-defense program.
defense|2026-07-20: Lockheed Martin had its biggest one-day rise in nearly 25 years after reporting a record order backlog, lifting the whole sector.
defense|2026-06-26: Defense stocks rallied after AeroVironment posted a record quarter and NATO countries promised more military spending ahead of their summit.
defense|2026-06-12: Defense stocks fell into a bear market on talk of an Iran peace deal and reports that Germany was scrapping warship orders.
defense|2026-04-16: Defense stocks dropped on worries about the Pentagon's budget request and as investors reassessed which companies really gain from the Iran war.
defense|2026-02-12: Defense stocks rose against a falling market as investors looked for companies that benefit from conflict and higher military budgets.
defense|2025-12-30: Defense stocks jumped after President Trump floated a $1.5 trillion military budget and the US struck Venezuela, raising war risks.
defense|2025-09-30: Defense stocks rose on more military spending abroad (Japan, Canada, Europe), led by drone maker AeroVironment.
defense|2025-06-25: NATO members agreed to raise defense spending sharply, lifting defense stocks; AeroVironment also jumped on its results.
defense|2025-04-07: Defense stocks bounced with the rest of the market after the 90-day tariff pause, helped by Europe's plans to spend more on defense.
defense|2024-11-11: Defense stocks and government contractors fell after President-elect Trump picked Elon Musk and Vivek Ramaswamy to cut government spending.
defense|2023-10-05: Defense stocks rose after Hamas attacked Israel and war broke out in the Middle East.
banks|2025-05-07: Bank stocks rose as the US and China agreed a trade truce, easing fears of a recession and reviving hopes for dealmaking.
banks|2025-04-22: Banks recovered as the trade war eased and hedge funds returned to buying bank shares.
banks|2025-04-09: Bank stocks jumped with the market when President Trump paused most tariffs for 90 days; strong trading results at Citigroup and others added to it.
banks|2025-03-28: Bank stocks sank after the 'Liberation Day' tariffs: investors feared a recession, fewer loans and a freeze in mergers and dealmaking.
banks|2025-03-03: Bank stocks fell as tariff threats and weak economic data raised fears of a US recession.
banks|2025-01-13: Strong fourth-quarter results from the big banks and a milder inflation report sent bank stocks higher.
banks|2024-10-31: Bank stocks jumped after Donald Trump won the election, on hopes of lighter regulation and more dealmaking.
banks|2024-07-29: Bank stocks fell on weak US jobs data that sparked recession fears.
banks|2023-12-08: Banks rallied as investors bet the Federal Reserve was done raising rates and would cut in 2024.
banks|2023-10-30: Bank stocks rose as bond yields fell from their highs and investors bet interest rates had peaked.
banks|2023-07-17: Bank stocks rose after the big banks' second-quarter results beat expectations.
banks|2023-06-01: Regional banks recovered from the spring banking crisis as inflation eased and fears of more failures faded.
banks|2023-04-28: First Republic Bank collapsed, the third big US bank failure in two months, and other regional banks' shares plunged.
banks|2023-03-03: Silicon Valley Bank failed after a run on deposits, followed by Signature Bank; fear of contagion hit bank shares worldwide, including Credit Suisse.
oil|2026-08-06: Oil and refiners rose as oil prices climbed again: the Iran ceasefire ended and a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz shipping route stayed out of reach.
oil|2026-07-07: Oil stocks rose as renewed US–Iran fighting lifted oil prices, with Goldman warning oil could pass $120 if Hormuz shipping stays disrupted.
oil|2026-03-23: Oil stocks rose during the Iran war while the wider market fell; oil prices swung on mixed signals about peace talks.
oil|2025-12-29: Oil stocks jumped after the US struck Venezuela and President Trump promised to revive Venezuela's oil industry with US companies.
oil|2025-05-07: Oil prices and oil stocks rose after the US and China agreed a trade truce, which lifted hopes for demand.
oil|2025-03-28: Oil stocks crashed as oil fell to a 3-year low: the 'Liberation Day' tariffs raised recession fears just as OPEC+ surprised by pumping more.
oil|2024-12-12: Oil stocks fell as forecasts pointed to too much supply in 2025, and the Fed's signal of fewer rate cuts hit the market.
oil|2024-09-27: Oil stocks rose as fighting in the Middle East raised fears of an attack on Iran's oil facilities.
oil|2023-09-29: Oil stocks fell as oil prices pulled back from near $100 a barrel.
oil|2023-07-07: Oil stocks rose as oil prices climbed for weeks on tighter supply from Saudi and Russian output cuts.
oil|2023-06-01: Oil stocks bounced as oil prices rose after China cut interest rates and OPEC+ kept supply tight.
oil|2023-03-28: Oil stocks jumped after OPEC+ surprised the market with a big cut to oil production.
oil|2023-03-07: Oil stocks fell as the bank failures (Silicon Valley Bank) raised fears of a recession, sending oil to its lowest in over a year.
oil|2023-01-27: Oil stocks fell as natural gas prices dropped and Chevron's quarterly profit disappointed, despite record yearly profits across Big Oil.
health|2026-10-09: Healthcare stocks rallied as investors moved money out of AI and chip stocks into safer sectors; Lilly, Merck and UnitedHealth led.
health|2026-08-17: Healthcare stocks rose while chip stocks were in a bear market, helped by Moderna's melanoma vaccine success.
health|2026-06-22: Investors moved out of tech into healthcare as a safe haven, sending AbbVie, Merck, J&J and Lilly to record highs.
health|2025-11-06: Healthcare stocks rose as investors rotated out of expensive tech and the government shutdown neared its end.
health|2025-09-25: Pfizer struck a deal with President Trump on drug prices, removing a big worry for drugmakers and lifting the sector.
health|2025-08-11: UnitedHealth had its best day since 2020 after Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway revealed a new stake.
health|2025-05-05: Healthcare stocks fell as President Trump ordered lower US drug prices, and UnitedHealth's CEO left abruptly amid reports of a Medicare fraud probe.
health|2025-03-31: Drug stocks fell on President Trump's tariff threats against medicines and the resignation of a top FDA vaccine official in protest at RFK Jr.
health|2025-01-21: Healthcare stocks rose on strong results (Abbott) and continued excitement over weight-loss drugs (Lilly).
health|2024-11-11: Healthcare stocks fell after Trump picked vaccine sceptic RFK Jr. to run the health department, and AbbVie's schizophrenia drug failed two trials.
health|2023-07-14: Healthcare stocks rose as UnitedHealth's results beat expectations.
health|2023-03-30: Healthcare stocks rose as investors looked for safety after the March banking crisis.
drop|2026-10-22: The tech sell-off deepened after Meta's results raised new worries about AI spending, and surging oil prices added pressure, even though company earnings were fairly good. Hedge funds had their worst day since Covid; defense and oil stocks rose.
drop|2026-10-12: An AI and chip sell-off: chip bosses warned about how AI spending is funded and China's chipmakers showed progress, while oil near $110 and rising rates added pressure. Oil, healthcare and defense stocks rose.
drop|2026-07-13: AI stocks sold off as the war with Iran escalated, oil jumped and the Fed paused instead of cutting rates. The Nasdaq broke key support levels; oil and healthcare stocks rose.
drop|2026-06-23: A global tech sell-off: fears of a memory-chip shortage and doubts about AI hit Micron, Sandisk and Nvidia, and South Korea's market plunged 10%.
drop|2026-06-01: Another sell-off in AI stocks and a crash in South Korean shares, with Iran negotiations adding uncertainty. Talk of a dot-com-style bubble grew.
drop|2026-03-26: The Nasdaq fell into a correction (10% below its record) as the Iran war widened and investors dumped high-flying chip stocks.
drop|2026-03-12: Stocks slid as the Iran war sent oil to $100 a barrel and worries about private credit funds grew.
drop|2026-02-12: Fears that AI will disrupt whole industries hit software, real estate, trucking and memory stocks, alongside a crash in gold, silver and crypto.
drop|2026-01-29: Big Tech's soaring AI budgets and fears that new AI models will replace software companies sent software stocks down about $1 trillion in a week.
drop|2026-01-20: President Trump's threat of tariffs over Greenland caused Wall Street's biggest daily drop in three months, led by tech stocks, before a framework deal brought a rebound.
drop|2025-12-11: Oracle's report of problems funding its AI data centres and Broadcom's margin warning revived fears of an AI bubble; the Fed also signalled fewer rate cuts.
drop|2025-11-13: Stocks fell as investors scaled back hopes for Fed rate cuts, Nvidia slid even after strong results, and a crypto sell-off spread to stocks.
drop|2025-11-04: The CEOs of Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley warned of a 10–20% correction, setting off a global sell-off in highly valued tech stocks like Palantir.
drop|2025-10-10: President Trump threatened big new tariffs on China, wiping about $2 trillion off US stocks in one day.
drop|2025-08-01: New tariffs from President Trump and a weak jobs report sent stocks down; Amazon also slid after its results.
drop|2025-05-21: A bond-market sell-off after the US lost its top credit rating and Trump's tax bill raised worries about government debt; higher yields hit stocks.
drop|2025-03-28: President Trump's 'Liberation Day' tariffs set off the worst crash since 2020: the S&P 500 fell 12% as investors feared a global trade war and recession.
drop|2025-02-21: The S&P 500 fell into a correction as tariff threats hit business and consumer confidence and the economy showed signs of slowing.
drop|2025-01-27: China's DeepSeek released a cheap, capable AI model, raising doubts about AI spending; Nvidia lost nearly $600 billion in one day, the biggest one-day loss in history.
drop|2025-01-10: A strong jobs report pushed the 10-year Treasury yield toward 5% as investors expected fewer rate cuts, pulling stocks down.
drop|2024-12-12: The Fed cut rates but signalled far fewer cuts in 2025, sending stocks sharply lower.
drop|2024-11-15: Fed Chair Powell said there was no hurry to cut rates, and Trump's pick of RFK Jr. hit health stocks.
drop|2024-10-31: A Halloween tech sell-off after Microsoft and Meta warned of rising AI costs.
drop|2024-09-03: Weak manufacturing data revived recession fears, and Nvidia lost a record $279 billion in market value in a day.
drop|2024-07-11: Investors rotated out of Big Tech after a cool inflation report, then a global sell-off followed weak US jobs data and the unwinding of the yen carry trade.
drop|2024-04-30: Stocks fell before the Fed meeting as stubborn inflation pushed back hopes of rate cuts.
drop|2024-04-10: A hotter-than-expected inflation report pushed back hopes of rate cuts and raised bond yields, hitting tech hardest.
drop|2024-01-31: Fed Chair Powell played down a March rate cut, and New York Community Bancorp's slump revived regional bank worries.
drop|2023-10-17: Rising Treasury yields and new US limits on AI chip exports to China hit tech and chip stocks.
drop|2023-09-15: The Fed signalled rates would stay higher for longer, pushing Treasury yields up and stocks down.
drop|2023-08-24: A short dip as investors waited for Fed Chair Powell's Jackson Hole speech on rates.
drop|2023-08-02: Fitch downgraded the US government's credit rating, sparking a brief global sell-off.
drop|2023-07-20: Tech stocks dipped after disappointing results and forecasts from Netflix and TSMC.
drop|2023-04-25: First Republic Bank's slide toward collapse and weak company earnings pulled stocks down.
drop|2023-03-22: Banking fears spread to Europe (Deutsche Bank) as the Fed kept raising rates despite the crisis.
drop|2023-03-07: Silicon Valley Bank collapsed after a run on deposits, the biggest US bank failure since 2008, hitting bank stocks worldwide.
drop|2023-02-14: Hotter inflation data raised fears the Fed would keep raising rates.
drop|2023-01-30: Stocks dipped ahead of a Fed meeting and big tech earnings.
drop|2023-01-18: Weak retail sales and factory data raised recession worries.
now|ai|2026-10-23: After an 8-day chip losing streak that ended on 16 Oct (the longest since 2008, about $2 trillion erased), AI stocks bounced on 19 Oct, then slid again after Tesla's and Meta's results raised spending worries. Investors kept moving into steadier companies.
now|defense|2026-10-23: Defense stocks rose as companies reported third-quarter results (Lockheed raised its guidance) and Goldman Sachs recommended defense as a hedge if the AI rally fails; they dipped on 19 Oct on bets that Democrats sweep the elections.
now|banks|2026-10-23: The big banks are on their longest losing streak since 2008 even though their earnings were decent; regional banks bounced.
now|oil|2026-10-23: Oil stays near $110 on Middle East and Russia–Ukraine worries, with US emergency oil reserves at their lowest since 1982. Oil dipped on 19 Oct when President Trump put new Russia sanctions on hold.
now|health|2026-10-23: Healthcare keeps gaining as investors move money out of AI and chip stocks into steadier sectors.
today|all|2026-10-23: Stocks slipped again (S&P 500 −0.5%) as worries about AI spending after Meta's and Tesla's results, and high oil prices, carried over from the day before. Telecoms fell sharply while cybersecurity rose.
now|all|2026-10-23: A second week of AI selling spread from chipmakers to the companies building AI data centres and their power supply, as investors grew nervous ahead of Big Tech's earnings. Oil stayed high and investors moved into bonds and defensive stocks.
today|ai|2026-10-23: Chip stocks steadied after their 8-day slide (+0.3%), led by Micron, Marvell and AMD, even though AI stocks had slid the day before on spending worries after Tesla's and Meta's results.
today|defense|2026-10-23: Defense edged up (+0.4%): Lockheed Martin kept rising after raising its guidance, and drone maker AeroVironment gained.
today|banks|2026-10-23: Banks fell 1.1%, led by the investment banks, a day after European banks tumbled as oil climbed.
today|oil|2026-10-23: Oil stocks rose 2.9% as oil prices kept climbing after US crude stockpiles fell more than expected earlier in the week; oilfield service companies led.
today|health|2026-10-23: Healthcare slipped 0.9% after a strong month, led by Lilly and UnitedHealth; analysts noted the sector's rally is itself a warning sign for the wider market.
